description: Read one wallet's balance of one ERC-20 token on Arbitrum One: raw amount, decimals, symbol and the human-readable amount, live from the token contract. Use to check stablecoin or token holdings before a transfer or trade; for the native coin use arb_balance. Both inputs are 0x addresses (40 hex characters); no contract returns 404 and a non-ERC-20 contract 422, both uncharged. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: arb_token_balance
title: Arbitrum One ERC-20 balance
